name: The Proving Grounds
description:
A walled courtyard just east of Ashveil's south gate, used by the city guard for training exercises. A sign on the stone arch reads: PROVING GROUNDS — AUTHORIZED TRAINING ONLY. Three passages lead deeper into the complex.

  East  — The Wanderers' Hall (recruit companions)
  South — The Ember Circle (campfire, rest & strategy)
  West  — The Gauntlet (combat arena)

name: The Wanderers' Hall
description:
A long hall where adventurers between jobs wait, trade stories, and look for work. Mismatched chairs and tables are scattered about. The guild board on the wall is covered in request notices.

Several capable-looking individuals occupy the room, waiting for an opportunity to join a party.

Type TALK <name> to speak with anyone. Type LOOK to see who is available.

name: The Ember Circle
description:
A circular stone courtyard with a large, well-maintained campfire at its center. Smooth logs serve as benches around the fire. The smell of pine smoke and woodsmoke fills the air. This is where soldiers and adventurers alike come to rest, plan, and prepare before the Gauntlet.

This is a campfire. You can:
  REST      — Restore all HP/MP and save your progress
  PARTY     — View your party members and their stats
  MANAGE <member> — Edit strategies for a party member
  LEARN <skill>   — Spend skill points to learn new abilities
  UPGRADE <mod>   — Spend modifier points to improve proficiencies

name: The Gauntlet
description:
A large open-air arena ringed by low stone walls. Practice dummies stand along the edges, but the real training opportunities wait in the marked combat zones at the arena's center. Each zone is cordoned off with rope and marked with a colored banner.

  [A] SOLO BOUT     — One opponent. Good for testing basic combat and speed.
  [B] SKIRMISH      — Three opponents of mixed types. Tests party cohesion.
  [C] SWARM         — Five low-level opponents. Tests AoE and multi-target strategy.
  [D] FULL ASSAULT  — Six opponents of varied levels. Maximum challenge.

Type ATTACK A, ATTACK B, ATTACK C, or ATTACK D to enter a combat zone.
Defeated groups respawn automatically after a short time.
